reviews.comment: Never take this professor. I genuinely am always angry at his grading and lectures. He decided to have things due AFTER FINALS. I was yelled at every lecture about how our class was never gonna be engineers but we would make good secretaries and politicians. The worst professor that you could ever take. Take Dr. Hartl over this man please.
If nothing else he sure was interesting.

He told us attendance was optional on the first day of class. However, after the first week, he would complain about attendance for half of the lecture time. He then started grading harsher. Halfway through the semester, he decided that if you missed more than 3 classes, you automatically lose 10% of your final grade. Please take a different prof.

Great professor. Cares about his students. Very knowledgeable about finite elements, but provides a surface-level explanation for students being introduced to the subject. He is very open to answering questions and explaining deeper concepts. Homeworks are free if you follow his lectures. Treat him with respect, and he will blossom.

Dr. Strouboulis presents you with a class that's entirely graded off of only six homeworks. You are given them four-to-five weeks in advance. Do them early or you will suffer.

He AGGRESSIVELY cares about your academic performance, though. Make sure to ask questions frequently, otherwise he will probably get sidetracked and everyone loses.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the worst class I have taken. Stroub makes class very hostile and rants and yells about anything, everything, and nothing. He often teaches the same lesson multiple classes in a row and expects us to learn from the hws he gives us, but doesn't want us to use those hws to complete our hws, so the result is getting yelled at no matter what.

This professor is one of the few people in Texas A&M's AERO department who knows how to teach a class where both the extremely interested and those just taking it for credit can succeed. The example homeworks are very well-written. Lecture derivations are extremely detailed and very helpful. I highly recommend taking his class!

This is an odball of a proffesor. He is not the best at teaching the material but he does genuinly care. He pushes back deadlines even if one person asks for an extension. Gives you example homeworks and test from past students and genuinly cares that you learn. Just be ready for some weird rants and to come 10 min before class and leave 10 min aft
Bad prof but easy grader. You get out what you put into this class.

Bruh idk what this other dude is talking about. His lectures are hard to follow but he provides you with his notes afterward. He gives a ridiculous amount of hw extensions even tho he gives us plenty of time to begin with. The homeworks are long but few and he gives you the answers to it. You need an 80 in the class to make an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: This man may be very smart, but man is he not a good professor. If you want to be constantly confused by lectures, swamped by homework, and repeatedly told how natural U.S. citizens are much lazier than immigrants, this is the professor to take.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy
